subject: Provisional lead coverage proposal and HR clearance
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisional coverage proposal for Payments team

Team —

I need to put a provisional coverage plan in place for Payments while Priya is on parental leave starting 8/16. This is expected to be ~6 weeks but could be shorter; we want a clean temporary assignment so the team isn't blocked for reviews or escalations.

Proposal (high level):
- Marcus to act as provisional lead for Payments (tech + triage owner) from 8/16 through 9/30, with an expected ~30% allocation to lead duties.
- Rishi to own any promotion/performance decisions in the period; Marcus to handle day-to-day feedback and run weekly 1:1s.
- Defer any non-urgent calibration or promotion discussions unless there is consensus to move forward.
- We will communicate publicly to the team tomorrow and update org chart + on-call rotations.

Attachments: org_chart_q3.pdf, manager_transition_checklist.xlsx (first pass).

Neha — can you confirm any HR approvals or paperwork required for a provisional assignment like this (manager transfer form, temporary role signoff, any compensation notes)? Also can you confirm whether we need a formal org change ticket in Core HR for a short-term coverage?

Marcus/Evelyn/Rishi — please confirm whether the allocation and responsibilities above work, and flag anything I missed. I want to publish a short note to Payments by EOD tomorrow if we have agreement.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional coverage proposal for Payments team

Thanks, Mina —

This is straightforward from an HR process perspective but we do need a very short sign-off loop so records are clear. Required steps:
1) Manager Transfer Form (I can draft and circulate; will need signatures from the outgoing manager (Priya), provisional lead (Marcus), and Rishi as director).
2) Temporary role note in Core HR (we mark it as "provisional coverage" with an end date; I will set 9/30 as the default and we can amend).
3) If there are any material changes to compensation/title for the period, that requires People Ops approval — sounds unlikely here.

If you want, I can start the Manager Transfer Form now and circulate for e-sign. Marcus, can you confirm you accept the provisional scope (list the 2–3 areas you don't want to be responsible for so I can capture exceptions)?

I will also add an item to HR-784 (linked) so we have an audit trail.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 12:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional coverage proposal for Payments team

Happy to take this on. Confirming the following provisional scope:
- Own day-to-day triage, incident escalations, and weekly engineering syncs.
- Run weekly 1:1s and handle performance feedback for immediate blockers.
- Not taking on formal promotion sign-offs or long-term roadmap reprioritization — Rishi will retain those.

Proposed quick cadence for 1:1s (starting 8/17):
- Mondays 10:00–10:30 (updates)
- Biweekly skip-level office hours Thursdays 3:00–4:00 (optional)

Neha — I accept the Manager Transfer Form; please include the expected end date and a note that Priya is on approved parental leave.

Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager (Payments)
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional coverage proposal for Payments team

Thanks all — I approve Marcus as provisional lead with the constraints below:
- Keep Marcus's lead allocation capped at ~30% of time. Marcus should not be expected to absorb release planning work that requires >2 days/week.
- Defer any promotion cycles tied to Payments until Priya returns unless there is an urgent, documented case.
- Mina: please coordinate a short all-hands next week (15 min) to announce coverage and whom to escalate to.

Also: ensure the on-call rotation is updated so Marcus isn't paged for routine infra noise; if necessary, rotate the on-call schedule for the next two cycles.

I'll ping Platform to confirm we won't have any blocking ops changes.

—Rishi
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 16:08:00 -07:00

Thanks — sending the public note to Payments now (below). Calendar: I scheduled the team sync and Marcus's 1:1s per the proposed cadence; invites sent.

--- Forwarded message ---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Temporary coverage for Payments (8/16–9/30)

Hi Payments —

Priya begins parental leave tomorrow. Marcus will act as provisional lead through 9/30 with Rishi retaining promotion/comp sign-off. Reach out to Marcus for day-to-day items and to Rishi for anything involving long-term roadmap or promotion cases.

Short notes:
- Marcus will be handling daily triage and weekly syncs.
- On-call rotation updated; if you receive unexpected pages please escalate to on-call backup.
- If you have open promotion or compensation cases, flag them to Rishi; we will triage after Priya returns unless urgent.

Thanks for keeping things smooth — please reply if you see any immediate blockers.

Mina
Director, Product Operations

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2027 17:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Provisional coverage proposal for Payments team — paperwork complete

All —

Manager Transfer Form has been completed and signed by Priya (outgoing), Marcus (provisional lead) and Rishi. I uploaded the signed form to the HR folder and attached a copy here (signed_manager_transfer_form.pdf). Core HR record updated to show provisional coverage through 2027-09-30.

Next steps:
- I will close HR-784 in 2 business days unless you request a change.
- If Marcus wants People Ops to run a short calibration with Rishi on any mid-cycle feedback, ping me and I will set it up.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.
—Neha
